current_date: Updated September 2026 (document revision history: agreed by Planning & Rights of Way Panel 11 Nov 2020; updated Feb 2024; updated Sept 2026 for May 2026 Flood Map changes and Aug 2026 NPPF)
current_evidence: The council's Submission guidelines page links 'Validation Checklists' and 'National and Local Validation checklists' only to this PDF. Search shows only older versions under the same media id (2023 'master copy' files from 2024 and 2025). The document's own revision note says 'Updated September 2026'.

issues.detail: Householder is recorded as '(none) - national requirements only'. That is wrong. The checklist has householder-specific local requirements: CIL Additional Information form where extensions, annexes or outbuildings add over 100 sq m GIA; minimum flood details for extensions/outbuildings in Flood Zones 2-3 (finished floor levels, flood level, EA Flood Warning sign-up); a Roof Plan for 2+ storey extensions and all roof alterations; and a Tree Survey where trees or hedgerows are lost or affected. A Heritage Statement, Biodiversity Survey and Site Sections apply where triggered. Grokbot actually captured the householder CIL text in tab_items but did not map it.
issues.evidence: CIL: 'Householder Development: Where the proposed development will add over 100sq.m of additional floorspace'; Roof Plan householder: '2 or more storey extensions, and all roof alterations'

issues.detail: Listed building consent is recorded as '(none)'. The standalone LBC checklist lists a Heritage Statement as its local requirement.
issues.evidence: Listed building consent (standalone) section: local requirement - Heritage Statement

issues.detail: Three requirements are filed under the wrong application types. 'Noise Impact Assessment' sits under Change of use - prior approval, but its excerpt is the Ventilation/Extraction Statement trigger for food-preparation and extraction uses, which belongs to full planning. 'Retail Impact Assessment' also sits under prior approval, but the source applies it to applications of 2,500 sq m+ Class E retail/leisure/office outside defined centres. 'Lawful development evidence (10 years continuous use...)' is placed under Full planning, but this is evidence for a lawful development certificate.
issues.evidence: 'Ventilation/Extraction Statement (including Acoustic Assessment) Required for all applications for uses involving food preparation...'; 'Retail Impact Assessment ... Required for applications of 2,500sq.m or more...'

issues.detail: About 25 rows say 'INFERRED: application type not named ... placed under Full planning'. The PDF is organised as separate checklists per application type, each with its own local list, so the applicability was stated and could have been read. Examples: Tree Survey and Heritage Statement also apply to householder; CIL also applies to s73 and prior approval ('Also applicable to s.73 applications ... and prior approval').
issues.evidence: Document structure: separate 'Householder', 'Full planning permission', 'Listed building consent', 'Advertisement consent', 'Outline' checklists

issues.detail: Local requirements not captured: Air Quality Assessment (all major development; non-householder development in or next to an AQMA or within 200m of a statutory nature conservation site; energy/industrial processes with direct emissions); Landscape (Hard & Soft) Design (all major development); a separate Noise Assessment (residential development affected by existing noise, major development generating or affected by noise, air source heat pumps/external plant); Statement of Community Involvement (formally required for 50+ dwellings or 1,000 sq m+ non-residential); Roof Plan (new pitched roofs and roof changes); Site Sections incl. levels (changes to ground levels or sloping sites); Affordable Housing Statement (10+ units, policy-compliant schemes); Refuse Management Plan (where carry distances exceeded or private collection proposed).
issues.evidence: Full planning local requirements list, Southampton Validation Checklists (Updated Sept 2026)

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are fragments or text from other items. Ventilation/Extraction carries the Planning Performance Agreement pre-application fee text. Photographs carries the archaeology desk-based assessment text. Floor plans/Elevations carries an equipment maintenance schedule fragment. Tree Survey reads only 'carry out a tree survey.' (the real trigger is protected/TPO trees or hedgerows lost or affected, including overhanging off-site canopies). Ecological reads only 'a designated protected species.' Block plan reads 'application including: o Block plan of the site (eg.'
issues.evidence: Tree Survey: 'Required for all applications where trees or hedgerows are proposed to be lost or would be affected'

issues.detail: Several main triggers misstate the thresholds. The Flood Risk Assessment excerpt is the SuDS sentence ('required for all MAJOR development'); a site-specific FRA is actually required for all proposals in Flood Zones 2/3 and for sites of 1ha+ in Flood Zone 1. The CIL excerpt is submission-process text and omits the 100 sq m / new dwelling trigger. Fire Statement omits the 'relevant building' trigger (2+ dwellings or educational accommodation, 18m+ or 7+ storeys). Viability omits the 10+ residential units threshold.
issues.evidence: FRA: required in Flood Zones 2 and 3 and for sites of 1 hectare or more in Flood Zone 1

issues.detail: 'Energy / Sustainability Statement' and 'Sustainability / Climate change checklist' both use the same nitrogen-budget sentence, so one requirement is entered twice. Neither gives the actual Sustainability Checklist trigger: 1+ residential units or overnight accommodation, HMO occupancy increases, or 500 sq m+ non-residential floorspace. The source has no separate Energy Statement item.
issues.evidence: 'Sustainability Checklist & Nitrogen Budget Calculation' - residential/overnight units, HMO increases, non-residential 500sqm+

issues.detail: 'Parking provision / Parking plan' is recorded as a requirement, but its own excerpt says the Transport Statement and Car Parking Stress Survey are 'Best practice, but not a validation requirement, for developments of 1-49 residential units'. 'Pre-application advice / engagement details' is web-page text ('More information about pre-application advice...'), not a validation item.
issues.evidence: 'Transport Statement & Car Parking Stress Survey ... Best practice, but not a validation requirement'

issues.detail: Several tab_items are process text, links or web boilerplate rather than requirements: 'This request can be by email to Planning@southampton.gov.uk as no formal application form exists'; 'More information on the Solent Disturbance and Mitigation Project Advertisement - helping to fund vital services'; 'More information on the Solent Disturbance and Mitigation Project .'; 'For more information on nitrates ... visit our nitrate mitigation page'; 'Process for demonstrating Nitrate Neutrality for a residential prior approval residential approval:'; and the post-decision Reg 75 nitrate discharge request text.

The householder CIL sentence ('Where the proposed development will add over 100sq.m...') appears three times in tab_items under 'Submission rules', each spliced with the next heading ('Flood Risk Assessment...F4:' and twice 'Contaminated Land Assessment...Required for:'). The SDMP mitigation sentence appears twice.

'Biodiversity Net Gain' and 'Design and Access Statement' are listed as local requirements. The checklist labels BNG a 'National Validation Requirement', and the DAS is a national requirement. The DAS excerpt is cut off mid-sentence ('within a designated area (ie.').
issues.evidence: '10% Biodiversity Net Gain - National Validation Requirement'

summary: Grokbot links the current Southampton checklist (Updated September 2026). The extraction misreads its per-application-type structure: householder and LBC are wrongly set to 'none', noise and retail requirements are misplaced under prior approval, many triggers are fragments or text from other items, and several local items are missing (air quality, landscape, noise, SCI, roof plan, site sections).
